title: Al Pacino Vacates Longtime Beverly Hills Rental Once Owned By Jackie Collins

The estate is now listed for sale at $15.95 million. Zoom TV Digital Updated Oct 19, 2026, 22:26 IST Al Pacino Vacates Longtime Beverly Hills Rental Once Owned By Jackie Collins (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello, File) Photo : AP Legendary actor Al Pacino has concluded his long-term residency at a historic Beverly Hills estate, marking the end of an 18-year chapter in the property's storied history. The residence, which was famously owned by the late novelist Jackie Collins, served as the Oscar winner's primary West Coast base from 2006 until his departure in 2024. Rather than purchasing a home in the area, Pacino opted for a long-term leasing arrangement. The property, situated in the prestigious Beverly Hills Flats, was originally acquired by Collins to serve as a private guest compound adjacent to her main residence. Following Collins' passing in 2015, the home was purchased by real estate investor Ben Nehmadi in 2016, who maintained the existing lease agreement with the actor for nearly another decade. A Look Inside the Historic Beverly Hills Estate The 0.69-acre property, which dates back to 1922, offers a blend of classic architecture and modern luxury. The main residence spans 5,200 square feet and features six bedrooms. Interior highlights include a spacious great room characterized by wood paneling, coffered ceilings, and a fireplace, complemented by a full wet bar and a pool table. The estate's outdoor amenities are equally extensive, boasting a full-sized tennis court, a swimming pool, a hot tub, and a cabana complete with an outdoor fireplace. The home has undergone significant transformations throughout its century-long existence. Notably, in 1938, architect Douglas Honnold—who later collaborated with John Lautner on the Beverly Hills Athletic Club—oversaw substantial renovations to the structure. While the specific monthly rental figures paid by Pacino during his tenure remained private, the property’s historical significance and prime location have kept it a notable fixture in the local real estate market. Market Entry and Current Status Following Pacino's move in 2024, the estate was officially listed for sale. According to reports from The Wall Street Journal, the property hit the market with an asking price of $15.95 million. This listing follows the 2016 acquisition of the home by Ben and Bita Nehmadi, who purchased the residence from the Collins family for $9 million. The property is currently seeking a new owner, closing the curtain on a unique period of Hollywood history that saw one of cinema's most recognizable figures residing in the former home of a literary icon.
